text: make a website for my cousin's clothing boutique called Thread & Loom in Pune. it sells handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas. people should be able to browse products by category, filter by size and price, see a size guide, check new arrivals, and order on whatsapp. also show a lookbook section with styled outfits, the store timings and location, the return and exchange policy, and a few customer reviews. it should feel earthy and elegant and work well on phones

@Requester Thanks, this is a clear brief. I need a few details only you or your cousin know, so nothing on the site is made up.
1. What is the WhatsApp number customers should order on, the full shop address in Pune, and the days and hours the shop is open?
2. What does the shop sell, item by item? For each one, please share the name, category (kurta, saree, cotton shirt or dupatta), price, sizes available, and whether it is a new arrival.
3. What are the return and exchange rules (for example how many days, and what condition items must be in), and what measurements go in the size guide (chest, waist, length for each size)?
4. How should we handle product photos, lookbook outfits and customer reviews?
   Option 1: I will send real photos, outfit combinations and real customer reviews (the site is complete once I send them)
   Option 2: Use stand-in pictures and sample outfit ideas for now, and I will send real reviews later (those parts stay marked as not final until then)
